kjv: by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe
mine: through faith in Jesus Christ for all who believe
note: pistis Iesou Christou may mean faith in Christ or Christ's own faithfulness; the KJV's literal "faith of" keeps the ambiguity that modern versions resolve. TR also adds "and upon all" (kai epi pantas).

kjv: a propitiation … for the remission of sins that are past
mine: a mercy seat … because … he (God) had passed over former sins
note: paresis is passing over, a temporary leaving unpunished, not "aphesis" (remission, forgiveness); the KJV erases Paul's argument that God's earlier forbearance needed vindicating. "hilasterion" is the LXX word for the ark's mercy seat (Heb 9:5).
